title: THE RENDER WEEK · The node count
venue: Arthur's site · a science-fiction week the papers declined · posted once, taken down
logline: Thursday: a number in the sky over the ridge, small, the way a frame counter sits in a corner, going up each panel, and the glow under it going up too — the first time the strip has drawn the glow since 1994 and it's inside a science-fiction week so it doesn't count. Wood counts anyway.

panels.composition: The ridge from town at dusk, a small numeral-shape in the sky's corner, a faint warmth over the trees.
